name: ogbl-collab

pilot.negative_source: sampled: 100,000 random node pairs per split (Hits@50)
pilot.rule_found_in_code_or_release: every one of the 235868 authors has a training (<= 2017) collaboration, and 0 valid/test positives touch an author without one; negatives are uniform over node pairs (lower-degree half share 0.502); 0.366 of test positives repeat a training pair
pilot.rule_stated_in_paper: 'a subset of the collaboration network between authors indexed by MAG'; train <= 2017, valid 2018, test 2019
pilot.sources_checked: Hu et al. 2020 NeurIPS (OGB, Sec. 5.2); ogb.stanford.edu linkprop page; collab.zip v1 (raw, split/time, mapping)
pilot.verification: release only: the T = 1 restriction is a property of the release; whether it is the subset rule or a consequence of it cannot be told

why_no_card: The universe needs an external author graph (for example OpenAlex), which the tool does not supply yet. The pilot's release-only checks have no tool pipeline yet.
